test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"scattering."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Scattering"** means to throw or spread things in different directions. (वस्‍तुओं को इधर-उधर बिखरा देना; छितरा देना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The wind was **scattering**__ the leaves all over the yard.*&l
